claims.text: Is INDIA Near the Top for Rural Electricity?

claims.support: Definition: Access to electricity, rural is the percentage of rural population with access to electricity.

claims.text: Comparing rural electricity access rates across 203 countries and territories based on World Bank data.
India has 99.9% of its rural population connected.
India has 77 times the rural power access of Angola.
claims.support: IND is 99.9 and AGO is 1.3, 99.9 / 1.3 is approximately 76.85

claims.text: The USA has 100% rural access. China also has 100%.
claims.support: USA value is 100%, CHN value is 100%

claims.text: At the bottom, Burundi has 3.6%, Central African Republic 2%, Angola 1.3%, DR Congo 1%, and South Sudan 0.7%.
How reliable is rural electricity in your country?

title.reason: India is near the top (rank 115 out of 203, though many are tied at rank 1, 99.9% is near 100%).

description.reason: Matches universe count of 203 and World Bank source.
